ownership_decision.invariant: Registry owns Skill and Version facts; Run reads them and never writes them.

boundary_decision.interaction: Run reads Registry-owned Skill and Version facts through a reader the composition root injects; Run never reaches into Registry storage.

domain_forces: The preflight functions took the Skill, Version and Test Case ids as three separate parameters; they now take them as one named target, which changed the cited lines themselves.
What the lines establish is unchanged: the Version is read through the injected Registry reader, and a missing reader is refused before anything is read.
implementation_design.decision: Cite the same path from the public entry to the ownership check at the lines it now occupies, starting at the function's own first line instead of inside its parameter list.
invariants_preserved: Registry owns Skill and Version facts; Run reads them and never writes them.
rejected_alternatives: Keep the three ids as separate parameters so the cited lines do not change: the code would stay harder to read to spare a citation.
Cite only the single line that calls the reader: the refusal when no reader is injected is part of what makes the collaboration safe, and it would fall outside the citation.
